comparisonRows.buyerCheck: List moisture, oil, aroma, oxygen, light and handling exposure before choosing paper, plastic or mixed-material packaging.
comparisonRows.practicalUse: Helps decide whether paper-based packaging can work alone or needs coating, liner, insert, inner bag or another structure.
comparisonRows.boundary: Do not claim food-contact safety or shelf-life performance without product-specific testing and documents.

comparisonRows.buyerCheck: Confirm storage time, retail channel, temperature, humidity and transit time before sampling.
comparisonRows.practicalUse: Prevents switching to an eco-looking structure that weakens protection for cosmetics, food-adjacent gifts or specialty retail products.
comparisonRows.boundary: MUGE PACKAGING can review packaging structure options, but cannot guarantee shelf life as a generic claim.

comparisonRows.buyerCheck: Check board grade, recycled or virgin material direction, lamination, varnish, coating and insert requirements.
comparisonRows.practicalUse: Connects sustainability goals with structure, print finish and durability instead of comparing material names only.
comparisonRows.boundary: Recyclability, compostability or regulatory claims require target-market confirmation.

comparisonRows.buyerCheck: Match pack structure to display needs, stacking pressure, e-commerce shipping risk and return-damage tolerance.
comparisonRows.practicalUse: A lower-plastic pack may still need stronger board, inserts or shipping cartons for real-world protection.
comparisonRows.boundary: No fixed MOQ, lead time, price or damage-rate promise is included in this map.

comparisonRows.buyerCheck: Collect material declarations, supplier documents, sample test feedback and local-market claim review before using sustainability language.
comparisonRows.practicalUse: Keeps the sourcing brief useful for EU, US, Middle East and international buyers without overstating compliance.
comparisonRows.boundary: This asset is a sourcing framework, not legal, food-contact or compliance advice.
